rationale: The startup crash is explicitly in V8 under MAS sandboxing; app startup or distribution build labels are plausible secondary descriptions. The reporter explicitly has no public minimal reproduction. Multiple crash logs, signing settings, one-line workaround calls and environment conditions do not supply a runnable MAS sample. 50393 and 50776 share MAS/TestFlight startup, EXC_BREAKPOINT, the ThreadPoolSingleThreadForegroundBlocking0 worker and V8 ThreadIsolation frames. 49281 shares MAS-only arm64/macOS26 V8 startup failure; 49522 shares macOS26 initialization EXC_BREAKPOINT/V8 frames but differs in thread. The latter two are accepted optional references, not strong coverage. 50790 occurs during offscreen paint rather than MAS startup. Upstream is optional because the report hypothesizes V8/Chromium handling and earlier 50776 explicitly reports that matching crash upstream; this is reporter/corpus evidence, not independently verified maintainer confirmation. Security is inappropriate for an ordinary crash without a vulnerability claim.
